description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class 'ValidationUniqueDaoTest' for testing the 'ValidationUniqueDao' class within the OrangeHRM project. The test cases verify the uniqueness of specific data values, such as employee IDs, usernames, and email addresses, through methods like 'isValueUnique'. It sets up test data fixtures and uses assertions to check expected outcomes for various scenarios.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ValidationUniqueDao's functionality related to value uniqueness checks within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of ValidationUniqueDao and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testIsValueUniqueForEmployeeId
methods.description: Tests the isValueUnique method for an employee ID, verifying that a duplicate employee ID returns false.

methods.name: testIsValueUniqueForSystemUser
methods.description: Tests the isValueUnique method for system user names, verifying both duplicate and unique cases.

methods.name: testIsValueUniqueForEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Tests the isValueUnique method for email subscribers, validating various scenarios including duplicate and unique email addresses.
